implemented: Default canonical route composition now registers Book Runtime handlers through a #59-owned lazy production seam.

Each request constructs the dedicated FirebaseRestBookDeliveryRepository and resolves only the authenticated recipient's current binding and matching bindingId.
The existing #74 worker owns schema, authorization, CAS, idempotency, persistence, and schedule enforcement; #59 does not duplicate those rules.
Missing runtime or Delivery credentials fail closed before repository mutation.
The existing BOOK_RUNTIME_ROUTES_ENABLED gate, generic auth/rate/CORS/body/response checks, and dedicated identity declarations remain unchanged and disabled in wrangler.jsonc.
